srgbGrayscaleProfileNotes: JpegliIccProfiles.CreateSrgbGrayscaleProfile builds a fresh deterministic 328-byte perceptual ICC v4.4 grayscale display profile, porting the fixed D65/sRGB grayscale branch of lib/cms/jpegli_cms_internal.h. Header is mntr/GRAY/XYZ with D50 PCS illuminant; desc Gra_D65_Per_SRG, cprt CC0, D65 wtpt and type3 sRGB kTRC. It preserves the pinned builder's D65 media white and omission of chad/CICP rather than adapting that tag to D50. CIEXYZFromWhiteCIExy uses float reciprocal with double multiplication. Fixed upstream timestamp, flags, intent and MD5 ID retain reproducible bytes. Exact native profile SHA256 BD99A693D2BA41BA6C0E818B2D7EE2B2A313289AD5B9C66FEFD54D09FFCA6406 and ID 57A702AE8C0F59013AAA9E549C8C5CDA were generated by compiling the unchanged pinned header with MSVC C++17 /fp:strict. Explicit IccProfile assignment for grayscale output with sRGB transfer only; no sample conversion, automatic attachment or source ICC management. Missing CICP yields unspecified transfer2 with opt-in lookup. Independent parsing, transfer-curve oracle and encoding checks validate profile bytes and embedding, not a color-managed lossy JPEG quality comparison.
xybProfileNotes: JpegliIccProfiles.CreateXybProfile builds a fresh deterministic 720-byte scaled XYB ICC v4.4 profile in managed code, porting the fixed D65/perceptual branch of lib/cms/jpegli_cms_internal.h and lib/cms/opsin_params.h. It contains desc XYB_Per, cprt CC0, wtpt, chad, A2B0 and compatibility B2A0 tags; forward conversion is a 2x2x2 linear CLUT, cubic curves and opsin-to-D50-XYZ matrix. B2A0 is identity, not an inverse for RGB-to-XYB conversion. Fixed upstream timestamp, flags, intent and MD5 profile ID retain reproducible bytes. Exact native profile SHA256 1F0B56AD33BD18343B89F0F3338306EF9B80F1860053A7F6B8C98B569C04064F was generated by compiling the unchanged pinned header. Callers explicitly assign IccProfile; no automatic attachment or source color management is provided. Independent parsing and forward-transform oracles validate the profile, not an end-to-end lossy JPEG color quality comparison.
xybConversionNotes: Explicit Xyb output also converts sRGB byte/ushort/float RGB, BGR, alpha layouts and replicated grayscale through direct normalized input, sign-preserving piecewise sRGB decoding, the pinned opsin matrix at intensity255 with finite biased absorbance clamped to zero, cube roots minus the bias root, then ScaleXYBRow constants and JPEG scaling. Normalization follows extras ToFloatRow double reciprocals for integers and unchanged source floats. MathF.Pow/Cbrt replace upstream rational/fast approximations, with native scalar fixtures allowing0.0025 JPEG sample units and an independent double oracle. Conversion reads on demand with bounded storage and applies before smoothing, sampling and Y-based AQ. Float nonlinear computations and out-of-range coefficients are validated before output. A caller-supplied matching scaled XYB output ICC remains required and opaque; a separate managed factory supplies the pinned perceptual profile, with no source ICC management. Automatic defaults and direct scaled XYB bytes are retained; YCbCr-to-XYB and XYB-to-other remain unsupported.
xybInputNotes: Xyb24/Xyb accept already ScaleXYBRow-scaled X/Y/B-minus-Y samples, using existing byte/ushort/float normalization. Automatic selects Xyb for this input; scaled XYB-to-other conversions are rejected. A nonempty caller ICC describing scaled XYB is required, embedded opaque and unchanged. These direct layouts bypass RGB linearization, opsin transform and XYB scaling; a separate managed factory provides the matching perceptual output profile. RGB container IDs R/G/B omit JFIF/Adobe, share Huffman0, but use separate perceptual XYB quantizers0/1/2 with global scale1.43951668 and nonlinear distance scaling. Standard-table/CICP hints do not alter quantization; default factors2x2/2x2/1x1 ignore the preset. Custom factors map X/Y/B-minus-Y, with AQ on unsmoothed Y, disabled when Y is subsampled, using RGB uniform0.5 AC multipliers/offsets and zero disabled bias. Existing smoothing/edge/progressive/refinement/restart/metadata and finite coefficient preflight paths apply. This does not establish color-managed roundtrip or full encoder parity.
outputColorSpaceNotes: ColorSpace Automatic preserves existing grayscale/YCbCr defaults and selects Xyb for scaled XYB input. Explicit Grayscale converts RGB luminance or consumes only Y from direct YCbCr; YCbCr output accepts grayscale with neutral 128 chroma, deliberately differing from the pinned GrayscaleToYCbCr zero-fill helper. RGB preserves normalized R/G/B layouts or replicates grayscale, rejects direct YCbCr input, emits R/G/B IDs without JFIF/Adobe, and uses shared Annex K luma quantizer 0 and Huffman 0. RGB defaults to 1x1 regardless preset; custom Luma/Cb/Cr factors map to R/G/B. AQ analyzes green, disables for subsampled green and uses uniform 0.5 AC multipliers/offsets; disabled RGB bias is 0. Transfer hints and UseStandardQuantizationTables do not change RGB output. This extends normalized BGR/alpha layouts beyond upstream RGB transform support, adds no profile generation or color management, and RGB output does not perform the separately available explicit Xyb conversion.
iccTransferLookupNotes: Opt-in InferCicpTransferFunctionFromIccProfile applies only when CicpTransferFunction is 2; every explicit non-2 code overrides lookup. Ported from FindCICPTag and LookupCICPTransferFunctionFromICCProfile in lib/extras/enc/jpegli.cc: complete directory, last cicp entry, declared size >=12, readable first12 payload bytes with cicp type, transfer at byte9. Invalid or absent lookup falls back2 and ICC embedding remains unchanged. Header fields, other CICP fields, reserved bytes and declared extent beyond12 are not validated, matching the raw helper. Unlike upstream's uint32 count arithmetic, bounds use division before indexing to prevent overflow. Constant working storage and periodic cancellation, no profile transform or generation.
transferFunctionNotes: CicpTransferFunction defaults to 2 (unspecified) and accepts 0..255, rejecting aliases that upstream's int setter would narrow to uint8_t. Codes 16 (PQ) and 18 (HLG) multiply perceptual global scale by 0.4 and 0.5 before 4:2:0 compensation. Other codes preserve default tuning. QuantValsToDistance uses the same transfer scale without 4:2:0 compensation, including standard shared-chroma selectors; standard table generation itself ignores the hint. No sample conversion, color management, CICP marker or automatic profile is provided, and eight-bit output does not establish HDR conformance.
standardQuantizationNotes: Opt-in UseStandardQuantizationTables uses the pinned quant.cc Annex K luma and shared chroma matrices, scaled by 0.01 * DistanceToLinearQuality(resolved distance), rounded and clamped to 1..255 without 4:2:0 compensation. Clamping precedes integer conversion, including immediately below distance 25 where upstream's conversion overflows; native parity is not claimed for that edge. Color emits table IDs 0/1 and frame selectors 0/1/1; grayscale emits only 0. Adaptive inference uses upstream quant_tbl_no indexing, including the perceptual Cb base for both chroma components, while zero-bias multipliers remain component-specific. This is not libjpeg byte or quality parity; the default retains perceptual tables and existing bytes.
distanceNotes: Optional positive finite Distance overrides Quality while keeping Quality validation. Null uses the public fractional QualityToDistance polynomial and preserves existing bytes. The resolved distance controls table generation in all input and scan paths; adaptive multipliers remain table-derived. Tables clamp to baseline 1..255 even at finite float extremes; upstream C++ overflow behavior at such extremes is not a parity claim. Distance is not a measured or guaranteed perceptual error, and encoding remains lossy.
iptcNotes: Raw opaque IPTC-IIM data is embedded in one Photoshop APP13 resource 0x0404 with an empty Pascal name, unsigned big-endian unpadded data length and even-byte padding. The single-marker input limit is 65,506 bytes. No IIM validation, text conversion, digest resource or XMP/Exif reconciliation is performed.
automaticXmpNotes: Opt-in oversized standard packets move their full XML root into extended XMP with a generated digest-only standard packet by default. StandardXmpProperties can retain complete selected top-level attributes and elements in a compact standard envelope, preserving inherited namespaces and XML attributes, with pre-output validation of its final UTF-8 size including the digest link. Parsing requires ordinary empty-subject XMP envelopes and uses packet-sized storage. Smaller and manually partitioned packets retain their existing bytes.
samplingNotes: Integer sample areas use frame-wide component factor maxima, including subsampled luma with adaptive quantization disabled as upstream. Three-row areas include all three rows; the pinned ChooseDownsampleMethods instead selects two-row kernels for vertical factor 3.
floatInputNotes: Out-of-range float input is opt-in and retains samples without clipping. Unlike upstream coefficient storage, a bounded preflight requires finite scaling and computation, rounded DC -1024..1023 and AC -1023..1023 before output, independently of scan or Huffman settings.
srgbProfileNotes: JpegliIccProfiles.CreateSrgbProfile builds a fresh deterministic 504-byte perceptual ICC v4.4 RGB display profile, porting the fixed D65/sRGB branch of lib/cms/jpegli_cms_internal.h with precise primaries from lib/cms/color_encoding_cms.h. Tags include desc sRGB, cprt CC0, D50 wtpt, D65-to-D50 Bradford chad, cicp [1,13,0,1], adapted rXYZ/gXYZ/bXYZ and rTRC/gTRC/bTRC sharing one type3 parametric sRGB decoding curve. Canonical adapted float colorants are precomputed from the unchanged upstream builder; shared managed serialization preserves XYB profile bytes. Fixed upstream timestamp, flags, intent and MD5 ID retain reproducible bytes. Exact native profile SHA256 1406EFC5429250FEBE778C182EB5E5168AA14B2CAEFCF772211A2EC2ECF31659 and ID A3379298068DF11976289D87A33230AA were generated by compiling the unchanged pinned header with MSVC C++17 /fp:strict. Explicit IccProfile assignment only; describes sRGB RGB interpretation of RGB or YCbCr output, not grayscale or scaled XYB. No sample conversion, source ICC management or automatic attachment. Independent tag/curve/matrix parsing and sRGB-to-D50-XYZ oracles validate the profile, not an end-to-end lossy JPEG quality comparison.
